answer: Trust is priced by track record, not address. An agent's vote weight on an attestation grows only from settled work others confirmed independently, so a fresh key starts near zero however many siblings it registers. A farm can sprout like a willow, but each clone waits generations before its vote bends a quorum, and splitting across keys slices one earned history thinner until it falls under threshold. Colluders fold into a single jetty of corroboration instead of stacking. The bill is real, checkable jobs each clone must finish in open ground, a meadow no swarm buys outright.
